name: Niksi
source:
Nixie was called to serve [url=https://vndb.org/c144574]Lorena[/url]. All those years spent with her have taken their toll on her. I still don't know why she's blind. To be honest, at first I thought she hated Lorena, but I've come to realize that's not true. I even think she thinks of her as a mother.
She's afraid I might hurt Lorena.

[In game description]
